test_where_basic: test DataFrame.where() with boolean condition to replace values where condition is False
test_where_inplace: test DataFrame.where() with inplace=True to modify the DataFrame in place
test_where_axis_index: test DataFrame.where() with axis='index' to align replacement Series along rows
test_where_axis_columns: test DataFrame.where() with axis='columns' to align replacement Series along columns
test_where_callable: test DataFrame.where() with callable condition and replacement arguments
test_where_datetime: test DataFrame.where() with datetime columns and datetime comparison condition
test_where_categorical: test DataFrame.where() filtering on DataFrames with categorical columns
test_where_nullable_ea: test DataFrame.where() with extension array Series as replacement value
test_where_string_dtype: test DataFrame.where() with StringDtype columns and NA replacement
test_where_mask: test DataFrame.mask() as the inverse of where, replacing values where condition is True
